verdict.rationale: Anytype documents a general import feature and a Markdown import path through its Obsidian migration guide (Channel Settings → Import → Obsidian), which creates one object per Markdown file. The pack has no evidence of Notion, Evernote or Roam importers. It also never says whether links, folder structure or attachments survive the import. missing for 10: documented Notion/Evernote/Roam importers, evidence that internal links, hierarchy and attachments are preserved, independent or hands-on corroboration of import fidelity.
